content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am unable to add [product_name] logic module [article_no]. This article number does not appear in the device selection window. I am using [product_name] V[version_no] demo. Please advise. Thank you, [user_name]

[article_no] is not compatible with network projects, which is why it cannot be selected in network mode. You need to switch to diagram mode to select a [article_no]. With the demo version, you can create a program but cannot transfer it to the device—transfers are only possible with the full version.
Here's a short video demonstrating the process.

Thank you very much [user_name]. I have another question and I trust you can help. Is it possible to download and upload ([product_name] maintenance) project with [product_name] V[version_no] demo, specifically for [article_no]? Thank you. Regards, [user_name]

As previously mentioned, the demo version doesn't allow program upload or download. Online monitoring is also not supported in the demo. For newer models like [article_no], you can copy the program on your PC to an SD card and insert this into the device. However, for [article_no], there is no SD card slot; instead, you need to purchase a memory module accessory. With this module, the program can only be copied directly from the device, not from the PC.
Thank you, sir. I managed to solve it by downgrading the software.

If you have the full version of any previous [product_name] V[version_no], you can upgrade to the full version of [product_name] V[version_no] free of charge. You may download the upgrade from this site: [url] [IMAGE]

analysis.insight_summary: A user is facing challenges selecting a specific hardware model ([article_no]) in the device selection menu of [product_name] V[version_no] Demo. The main issues are incompatibility in network project mode and limitations on upload/download features due to both the demo software and device hardware, leading to uncertainty around software capabilities for maintenance.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to select the [article_no] hardware within the device selection menu, and to perform upload/download of program data using the demo version for routine device maintenance.
